title: A solo session with no parent and no cs-build tag may take the batch-runner hat for its own merge
why: The merge role file has no form for a solo session that the owner started (follow-up of step merge-role-allow). Owner question 00:17 CST Nov 15 (relayed by the consultant 00:24 CST): "did our conversation on roles as hats land? to main is that how things wokr now?". Answer, 00:18 CST (REST reads at main 20963a214992 unless marked relayed). The ruling is on main: docs/decisions/session-tiers.md, bullet "Roles are hats" (owner, 2026-11-10 14:33 CST, "yes hats model works"; one-lane chat rule added in commit eac750146, 2026-11-11 20:11 UTC). Meaning: a session role is a set of jobs and a session may wear several; in a one-lane run that lane holds every role it needs (writes its own page items as triage, merges its own PR as batch runner); how many sessions share the roles depends on the size of the run, never on local versus cloud. It is a decision record on main; the loaded CLAUDE.md carries the collapse to coordinator or lane (session roles) but not the hats wording (read from this session's loaded CLAUDE.md). The merge-side part is NOT on main: PR #2701 (solo session wears the batch-runner hat for its own merge) is open, draft, head 35df574ffd55, mergeable_state dirty, base fccff95e (old), 17 commits, last updated 2026-11-13 18:01 UTC (12:01 CST Nov 13); the coordinator asked to rebase it 00:24 CST Nov 15 (relayed). So today the hats model is the ruling and governs the roles' jobs, but a solo session still cannot wear the batch-runner hat at the merge guard until #2701 merges. Not read: #2701's diff; whether other guards read hats.
note: Pick taken by the coordinator, no page item (16:32 CST Nov 7): option C. The session-start hook writes merge role 'solo-owner' into the role file only when the session has no parent and no cs-build tag. read_merge_role accepts it only when the session id in the file equals the calling session's own id. Coordinator pick, 18:18 CST Nov 7, can be undone (round 3, lane [ended:notes-reverify-flags]): a solo owner session's merge confirm runs with no ask only in repos whose standing-merge-grant record grants solo merges (claude-settings today). Elsewhere the ask stays, and an untagged coordinator is refused. No page item. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was merge-role-raw-paths).
